iliana: Heads-up: ap-southeast2 is getting a cluster of tiny pods (0.125 GPU) that keep orbiting and getting evicted in bursts. Looks like taint propagation + scale-down timing interacting badly with our slab packing.
omar: Yep, telemetry shows a sawtooth: pending -> scheduled -> attach -> evict -> reschedule loops. Eviction_reason often 'taintMismatch' even though pods had tolerations.
reece: Quick example from a trace: 
```
I0715 04:02:11 scheduler.go:329] binding pod tiny-eval-84 -> gpu-node-11 (slot_alloc=0.125)
I0715 04:02:12 attach-controller.go:104] attach succeeded for tiny-eval-84 device=1
I0715 04:02:30 node-agent[evict]: eviction decided tiny-eval-84 reason="taintMismatch: gpu.redwood/slot-slab=0.5"
I0715 04:02:31 scheduler.go:411] rescheduling tiny-eval-84
```
reece: The node had `gpu.redwood/slot-slab=0.5` and later a background taint update from autoscaler flipped the slab label to 1.0 during scale-down, and our taint-sync controller applies taints after label changes causing a narrow window where pods no longer match.
iliana: So it's a race between label change and taint application. If taint applied after the pod was bound, eviction triggers.
omar: Looks like the taint-sync controller's idempotency loop uses eventual consistency and a 10s jitter. Combined with our aggressive scale-down that tears down warmpools, we get that window often.
reece: Proposed mitigations: 1) make taint-sync fast-path: apply taint changes before label flips by ordering the controller to annotate node with `pending-taint-change` and perform taint swap in a single transaction where supported, 2) add a short grace period in eviction-controller to ignore taintMismatch evictions for pods with recent attach (<60s), 3) adjust autoscaler scale-down cooldown for warmpool nodes to 2m.
ops-runner: For immediate relief I can pause scale-downs for warmpool pool in ap-southeast2: `ops scale --pool warmpool-apse2 --min=6 --max=20` to keep small slots around. Executing now.
ops-runner: Scale config applied. Also cordoned two nodes we saw flapping to avoid more churn.
iliana: Thanks. I'll open a small PR to change eviction-controller to check attach age and suppress eviction if attach age < 60s and node label changed recently. That should reduce the thrash while we change taint ordering.
omar: I'll add a preflight check in taint-sync to annotate before writing label updates. For stores that don't support transactional ops, fall back to a best-effort ordering and emit a metric `taint_sync_latency_ms`.
reece: Also add a regression test simulating concurrent label+taint updates with heavy tiny-pod churn. We should measure how many pods experience taintMismatch over 5m.
sched-bot: deploy job queued: taint-sync/ordering-fix #211 -> staging (ap-southeast2)
iliana: One more quick fix: add a telemetry alert when `eviction.reason=taintMismatch` spikes >50/min for any region. We missed early signal.
omar: +1. Also track `attach_age_at_eviction` histogram for debugging.
ops-runner: Warmpool pause in effect. Early telemetry: pending count dropped 18% and eviction spikes subsided.
reece: I'll own the postmortem and list action items: 1) taint-sync ordering + metric (omar), 2) eviction-controller attach-age grace (iliana), 3) autoscaler cooldown bump for warmpools (ops), 4) telemetry alerts for taintMismatch spikes (reece).
iliana: PRs: https://git.redwood/taint-sync/pull/211 and https://git.redwood/eviction-controller/pull/47. Canary rolling to staging now.
sched-bot: deploy job started: eviction-controller/attach-grace #47 -> canary (ap-southeast2)
reece: Thanks everyone. If we still see any tiny-pod orbiters after the canary, we'll fall back to a controlled rebalancer to move pods off nodes with label churn.
iliana: Will monitor for 30m and update postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
